comparison.objective: Secure a T-shirt to a clothesline with two pegs.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cloth handling and simultaneous spring-clamp capture of fabric and line.
comparison.success_condition: Two valid pegs ≥100 mm apart support the shirt ≥20 mm above the table for 5 s; damage or external support zeros.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable fastening with clamps, not rigid many-body sifting.
